articles.title: US midterms: key takeaways from Senate debates in Michigan, Georgia and Maine
articles.summary:
Candidates traded personal attacks and clashed over a range of issues in closely watched US Senate debates on Thursday, with control of Congress at stake

With just weeks left in the contentious midterm election campaign, candidates in a trio of highly-competitive Senate races debated Thursday night, clashing over the economy, tariffs, the Iran war and abortion rights, with control of the upper chamber at stake.

In Georgia, incumbent Democratic senator Jon Ossoff faced GOP representative Mike Collins. In Michigan, Democrat Abdul Al-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers debated over the state’s open Senate seat. And in Maine, longtime senator Susan Collins met Democratic challenger Troy Jackson. Democrats need to flip four Republican-held Senate seats to win the majority.

Pentagon chief joins Trump in attempt to use deadly shooting at Texas base to attack former Democratic president

  • Thousands turn out to welcome weary USS Lincoln sailors

  • Sign up for the US Breaking News email

Donald Trump has urged James Talarico, the Democratic nominee in the US Senate race in Texas, to debate Ken Paxton – Republican attorney general that the president has endorsed in the election.

On Truth Social, Trump described Paxton as “ready, willing, and able” to take on Talarico – the 37-year-old state representative who has been leading in several polls.

In Georgia, Jon Ossoff, the Democratic incumbent will face off against Mike Collins – a congressman and the Trump-backed Republican nominee at 7pm ET.

At the same time in Michigan, progressive insurgent Abdul El-Sayed, will debate Mike Rogers, the Republican nominee also endorsed by the president.

Finally, it’s the second debate in Maine in as many days. Susan Collins, the five-term Republican incumbent will spar (again) with the Democratic nominee, Troy Jackson, at 8pm ET.

Současně se zostřuje politické napětí před nadcházejícími volbami, rostou obavy z inflace a cen energií a administrativa řeší mezinárodní krizové situace včetně hrozeb hurikánu na pobřeží.

Simultaneously, political tensions are mounting ahead of upcoming elections, concerns over inflation and energy costs are rising, and the administration is addressing international crises alongside severe weather threats.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued heightened volatility and consolidation in tech markets are expected as investors closely monitor macroeconomic data and geopolitical developments.

archive.security_status_cs: Americké trhy čelí silnému otřesu po výprodeji v technologickém sektoru vyvolaném čínským modelem DeepSeek a rostoucím obavám z inflačních tlaků souvisejících s umělou inteligencí. Politická napětí eskalují v souvislosti s kontroverzními výroky Bílého domu ohledně zahraniční politiky a nadcházejícími midtermy, zatímco blížící se tropická bouře Isaias hrozí narušením infrastruktury na pobřeží Mexického zálivu.
archive.security_status_en: U.S. markets are facing a severe shock following a tech sector sell-off triggered by China's DeepSeek model and rising concerns over AI-driven inflationary pressures. Political tensions are escalating amid controversial White House foreign policy remarks and upcoming midterms, while approaching Tropical Storm Isaias threatens infrastructure disruptions along the Gulf Coast.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu s důrazem na rotaci kapitálu do bezpečnějších aktiv, přičemž investoři budou vstřebávat dopady technologického výprodeje.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued volatility is expected with an emphasis on capital rotation into safer assets as investors absorb the impacts of the tech sell-off.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí kombinaci prudkého výprodeje v technologickém sektoru vyvolaného obavami z konkurence v oblasti AI (DeepSeek) a rostoucím výnosům státních dluhopisů. Domácí bezpečnostní složky mezitím úspěšně zmařily teroristický útok inspirovaný ISIS v Minnesotě, zatímco blížící se hurikán Isaias ohrožuje pobřeží Mexického zálivu a vyvolává obavy o energetickou infrastrukturu.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing a combination of a sharp tech sector sell-off sparked by AI competition fears (DeepSeek) and rising Treasury yields. Meanwhile, domestic security agencies successfully thwarted an ISIS-inspired terrorist attack in Minnesota, as approaching Hurricane Isaias threatens the Gulf Coast and raises energy infrastructure concerns.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou volatilitu a nervozitu na trzích, přičemž investoři budou nadále přehodnocovat ocenění AI sektoru a sledovat vývoj kolem hurikánu Isaias.
archive.forecast_en: Increased volatility and market nervousness are expected in the coming days as investors continue to reassess AI sector valuations and monitor developments around Hurricane Isaias.

Domestic political tension is also escalating due to fierce debates ahead of the November midterms, ICE incidents in New York, and lingering geopolitical risks in the Middle East.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na technologických trzích, zvýšenou opatrnost investorů kvůli politické polarizaci před midterms a sledování škod způsobených hurikánem Isaias.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in technology markets, heightened investor caution due to political polarization ahead of the midterms, and monitoring of damage caused by Hurricane Isaias are expected in the coming days.
